title: Midnight Ember Ceramic Mug
description: Hand-thrown stoneware mug with a matte charcoal glaze and a warm copper rim. Holds 12 oz, dishwasher-safe, and built for slow mornings.

title: Alpine Breeze Bamboo Cutting Board
description: Sustainably sourced bamboo cutting board with juice grooves and a non-slip base. Measures 16x10 inches — perfect for meal prep and serving.

title: Harbor Glow Desk Lamp
description: Minimal brass desk lamp with a warm dimmable LED and a weighted marble base. Ideal for late-night reading or focused work.

title: Cedar Trail Wool Throw
description: Soft merino wool throw in forest-green herringbone. Lightweight enough for summer evenings, warm enough for winter nights.

title: Linen Drift Apron
description: Stone-washed linen apron with adjustable straps and a deep front pocket. Made to look better with every kitchen spill.

title: Pebble Rest Incense Holder
description: Sculpted ceramic incense holder shaped like a river stone. Catches ash cleanly and sits quietly on any shelf.

title: Northstar Enamel Kettle
description: Classic stovetop kettle with a matte navy enamel finish and a loud, cheerful whistle. Holds 1.7 liters.

title: Sunwell Glass Carafe
description: Borosilicate glass carafe with a cork stopper. Keeps water, juice, or cold brew looking as good as it tastes.

title: Forge & Grain Chef Knife
description: 8-inch high-carbon steel chef knife with a walnut handle. Balanced, sharp, and built for daily prep.

title: Moonlit Cotton Pillow Set
description: Set of two organic cotton pillows with a faint indigo stripe. Breathable, machine-washable, and hotel-level plush.

title: Copper Vein Plant Mister
description: Fine-mist copper sprayer for houseplants. Adds a little ritual to watering day.

title: Quiet Hour Notebook
description: A5 dotted notebook with thick cream paper and a cloth-bound cover. Lies flat so ideas do not have to wait.
